entries.zh: 宽恕、饶过（手放高：抬贵手放过、手下留情）
entries.en: to pardon, to let off; lit. to lift the hand and let go, to be lenient

entries.zh: 赦免、宽赦（罪过、刑罚）
entries.en: to pardon; to absolve (an offence)

entries.zh: 赦宥、宽恕开释
entries.en: to pardon; to forgive, show clemency

entries.zh: 量情、酌情宽宥（视情由从宽处置）
entries.en: to weigh the circumstances; to pardon leniently according to the case
entries.notes: 量情本义斟酌情由，与 perdonar 的关联取从宽裁断之义推断。

entries.zh: 劳烦、有劳（客套语：麻烦他人代劳）
entries.en: to trouble (someone); polite formula 'sorry to trouble you'
entries.notes: perdonar 与劳烦的对应系推断自客套语 perdone vm.（劳驾饶恕）的用法。

entries.zh: 曲处、部分从宽发落（宽减部分债欠）
entries.en: to forgive part of a debt; to deal leniently with part (of a case)
entries.notes: 曲取古义部分、从宽（如曲赦），配合西语 perdonar parte de la deuda 解作部分宽免；por luego 难确解。

entries.zh: 初犯从宽、放过他（初次冒犯即予饶恕）
entries.en: to pardon a first offence; to let him off

entries.zh: 将就、迁就（容忍将就、不计较）
entries.en: to put up with, to make do; to bear with and overlook
entries.notes: 西语后段文字难辨，将就与 perdonar 的关联取容忍、包容之义推断。

entries.zh: 将功补过（以功劳抵补过失而获宽恕）
entries.en: to atone for a fault with merit; to redeem one's faults by good service

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔original defective, gloss doubtful〕
entries.notes: 首字鏡/銷两可、銷裕非通行词，西语 çufis 亦难复原，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 将心、将心比心（设身处地体谅他人）
entries.en: to put oneself in another's place; to forgive by empathy
entries.notes: 西语栏文字破损；将心取将心比心之义推断。

entries.zh: 赐免、蒙恩准宽赦
entries.en: to grant pardon; to bestow remission (of a penalty)

entries.zh: 恕让、宽恕礼让
entries.en: to forgive and yield; to pardon with forbearance

entries.zh: 纳势、因人情势说情而宽宥（看情面赦免）
entries.en: to pardon upon someone's intercession; to spare for the sake of influence
entries.notes: 首字納/訥存疑；纳势非通行词，取接纳（说情之）势推断，对应 perdonar por intercesión。

entries.zh: 招安、总赦招抚（对乱众颁降大赦以安抚）
entries.en: general pardon, amnesty; to offer amnesty and pacify (rebels)

entries.zh: 相谅、互相宽恕（量通谅）
entries.en: to forgive one another; mutual forgiveness
entries.notes: 相量之量当为谅的同音借字，据西语 Perdonarse unos a otros 解作彼此宽恕。

entries.zh: 起动、劳驾（请托致歉的客套语）
entries.en: polite formula 'excuse me / sorry to trouble you'
entries.notes: 亞字与音写后半未能落实；西语 ſle canse 疑为 no se canse（不必费神）之残迹。

entries.zh: 打搅、打扰（冒昧搅扰的客套语）
entries.en: to disturb, to bother; 'excuse me for troubling you'

entries.zh: 沦、沦亡（沉没陷溺；谓死亡、覆灭）
entries.en: to perish; to sink, come to ruin; to die

entries.zh: 懒、懒惰
entries.en: lazy, idle
entries.notes: 西语词头 Perepon 疑为 perezoso（懒惰）之转写，释义以汉字懒为准。
